w: After his morning puja, on New Year's day, Swamishri expounded on Vachanamrut Sarangpur 7 and blessed the devotees.

980 devotees had participated in the yagna for peace. Swamishri worshipped the murtis of Akshar Purushottam Maharaj, Radha Krishna Dev, Hanumanji, Ganapatiji and Guru Parampara to be consecrated the next day in the Haveli.
During the yagna Swamishri initiated two youths from America - Saurabh Bhakta (Nachiketa Bhagat) and Pranav Vyas (Kanaad Bhagat).

In the evening a symbolic 80th birthday celebration of Pramukh Swami Maharaj was held. The balaks and kishores performed a thrilling folk dance. Then various dignitaries addressed the assembly with Swamishri finally blessing the 10,000 devotees and well-wishers.

Swamishri was suffering from neck pain and back pain and a stomachache. Doctors thoroughly checked Swamishri and prescribed medicines and rest. In the evening at 6.15 pm, Swamishri reached Jetpur and performed a foundation stone-laying ceremony fo a Hari mandir. After blessing the assembly, Swamishri departed for Gondal and arrived at Akshar Mandir at about 8.15 pm. After a warm welcome, Swamishri blessed the assembly.
Sharad Punam From 4.10 am, Swamishri presided over the lunar eclipse assembly. After the eclipse, Swamishri bathed and performed his morning puja.
After Swamishri’s lunch, the Ugandan High Commissioner to Kenya, H.E. Jali Gonza, came to receive Swamishri’s blessings.
From 5.15pm the Sharad Punam assembly commenced. During the three-hour assembly, as per tradition, the arti was performed five times.

Today also marked Swamishri’s last night in Nairobi before returning to Mumbai after a hectic six-month Satsang Tour of USA, UK and Africa. Hence, Bhaktavatsal Swami and senior devotees garlanded Swamishri. Finally, blessing the assembly, Swamishri said, “Only by great spiritual merits does one gain the company of God, Satsang and the holy Sadhu, and understand their glory. Maharaj incarnated on earth and brought His abode, Gunatitanand Swami, with Him. Today we are celebrating Gunatitanand Swami’s birthday and we have to understand his glory also.”

Guest: H.H.Gajpati Divyasinh Dev Maharaj, King of Jagannathpuri, expressed, “I think the person who comes here would get the impression that life is meant for a spiritual journey and it is only the spirituality that really matters. Akshardham will be a call for a better world, better future and glorious human existence in the days to come.”

Mahendrabhai (Pij), a veteran devotee, came for Swamishri’s darshan. Swamishri recognized him instantly and asked him how he was. On seeing a little child with him Swamishri enquired who he was. “He is my grandson,” he replied. Mahendrabhai’s son, Jaimin, was also with him. Swami asked Jaimin, “Do you come to the mandir? Do you attend the Sunday assembly?” Jaimin remained quiet. A sadhu replied that he doesn’t come to the mandir. “Do you come?” Swamishri asked Mahendrabhai. “I come everyday, from morning.” “Then why don’t you bring him along with you!” Swamishri added. “Oh, he is asleep then.” “Then you must wake him up. Didn’t your mother wake you up! Similarly, you should wake him up. Just as your mother woke you up and kept you engaged in satsang, likewise you should wake him up and bring him into Satsang.” Swamishri revives and consolidates satsang in the lives of youths who have lapsed from Satsang.
More than 1551 male and female devotees from Rajkot in the age group of 7 to 67 years pilgrimaged 38 km on foot to commemorate the Centenary of BAPS. Seven sadhus also joined in the pilgrimage.

At 6.40 p.m. Swamishri arrived on stage for the mahapuja rituals of Chopda pujan. The function was arranged on the mandir grounds. Thousands of accounts books were arranged neatly on stage. Swamishri participated in the mahapuja rituals till they concluded at 7.40 p.m. Viveksagar Swami addressed the large number of devotees. Finally, Swamishri blessed everyone, “People either take their accounts books to a mandir for sanctification or they do the rituals at home. The rituals are done to bless one with pure thoughts so that one can earn money successfully and use it in a benevolent way. The rituals may appear formal, but they are in accordance to our shastras and culture. God is pleased by such rituals. We always have God in the forefront of all our festivals. By keeping God in the forefront of all our activities, God will bless us.” In conclusion, Swamishri blessed all the accounts books by showering flower petals and rice grains.
